title: What's New: Power BI Reports for Sustainability (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Sustainability Power BI Reports

features.name: Realized Emissions vs Target Report
features.description: Power BI report showing realized emissions compared to sustainability targets for carbon equivalent, methane, and nitrous oxide, including change tracking and scope/category breakdowns.

features.name: Realized Emissions vs Baseline Report
features.description: Power BI report comparing realized emissions against baseline values for carbon, methane, and nitrous oxide, with scope and category analysis.

features.name: Water and Waste Analysis Report
features.description: Power BI report for water and waste analytics including water intensity by country and facility, waste tracking, and year-over-year changes.
caveats: Requires responsibility center setup as facility operation

features.name: Carbon Equivalent Analysis Report
features.description: Power BI report showing carbon equivalent calculations derived from all emissions converted to CO2 equivalent, including analysis by category and month.

features.name: Emissions to Revenue Ratio Report
features.description: Power BI report comparing emissions versus revenue to show the relationship between carbon emissions growth and business revenue growth.

features.name: Carbon Credit Tracking Report
features.description: Power BI report for tracking purchased carbon credits by month to measure carbon offset activities.

features.name: Sustainability Overview Report
features.description: Power BI report providing KPIs and overview for greenhouse gas emissions, water, waste, and carbon equivalent analysis.

features.name: Social Analysis Report
features.description: Power BI report for ESG social governance reporting including employee demographics, absence hours, gender distribution, age distribution, qualifications, and union membership.
caveats: Currently limited employee data available; planned expansion in future releases

features.name: Sustainability App
features.description: New sustainability app being introduced in version 26.1 to support emissions tracking, water and waste analysis, and ESG reporting.
